abilities.name: Wildcard
abilities.description: Once per encounter, as your Basic Action, pay 6 Hope to play any Common card, even if you don't actually have that card.

abilities.name: Bargain
abilities.description: Wildcard's Hope cost drops from 6 to 4.

abilities.name: Quick Draw
abilities.description: Wildcard can be used once per round instead of once per encounter.

abilities.name: Momentai
abilities.description: When you would take damage, you may pay 3 Hope to activate Momentai. Until the end of the round, whenever you would take damage, reduce that damage to 0 and add the prevented damage to a Damage Pool. At the end of the round, apply all damage in the Damage Pool to you at once.

abilities.name: Wider Net
abilities.description: Wildcard now works on Uncommon cards as well as Common.

abilities.name: Blue Card
abilities.description: Once per encounter, as your Basic Action, pay 3 Hope and roll 1d10. On a 9 or 10, you may play a Secret Rare card, even if you don't have one. On a 5 to 8, you may play a Rare card, even if you don't have one.
